claim: Regulation layer infrastructure (Phase R1) created in cell_sim/layer4_regulation/ with rule factory scaffolding for TF binding, sigma factor competition, riboswitch folding, and two-component signaling. The regulation network configuration file (cell_sim/data/regulation_network_syn3a.yaml) is intentionally empty pending future biological curation. No regulation rules are wired into the production essentiality sweep. No MCC claim is made for this phase. The four rule factories raise a BiologyNotCurated warning when invoked without an explicit source_citation argument; tests suppress the warning to verify only the architectural contract.
source_detail: Reproducible via the new test suite at cell_sim/tests/test_regulation_infrastructure.py (13 tests, all passing). The bit-identity gex-off regression test at cell_sim/tests/test_phase2_gex_off_bit_identity.py continues to pass under RUN_PHASE2_REGRESSION=1, confirming v15 and v16 baselines are unaffected by the new layer. Confidence value is 'assumed' rather than the spec's suggested 'implemented' because the invariant checker (memory_bank/.invariants/check.py + ranges.json) restricts confidence to {measured, inferred, estimated, assumed}; 'assumed' is the closest match for placeholder kinetic parameters that have not been measured.
caveats: Phase R1 produces infrastructure only. The four regulation rule factories work syntactically but have not been called with biologically-curated parameters. No regulatory entries exist in cell_sim/data/regulation_network_syn3a.yaml.

The simulator's production sweep does not invoke the regulation layer. v15 and v16 MCC values (mcc_against_breuer_v15_round2_priors, mcc_against_breuer_v16_gex_compiled) are unchanged from prior measurements. The Phase 2 gex-off bit-identity regression test passes, confirming this.

Wiring regulation into production requires (a) curating regulation_network_syn3a.yaml from real Syn3A regulatory data, (b) extending real_simulator.py to invoke initialize_regulation_state when an enable_regulation flag is set, (c) measuring v17 MCC and comparing to v16. None of these are part of Phase R1; see Phase R2 in FUTURE_WORK.md for the curation checklist.

The 'BiologyNotCurated' warning class exists explicitly to flag any future use of the rule factories with placeholder data. This is not a bug; it is a required safety check. Production code (Phase R2 wiring) MUST pass source_citation so the warning never fires.

The YAML loader at cell_sim/layer4_regulation/network_loader.py rejects any populated entry that is missing source / confidence / curated_on provenance fields. This is intentional and unmovable: the loader cannot be coaxed into accepting placeholder biology by editing the YAML alone.

Confidence value 'assumed' rather than 'implemented' because the invariant checker's allowed list does not include 'implemented'. The deviation from the session brief is documented in source_detail above and in the commit message; the substance ('this is infrastructure, not biology') is preserved.
Total diff for this phase is well under the 2500-line cap: ~840 lines of new code + ~280 lines of tests + ~80 lines of YAML schema documentation.
